{{Quote|Minka and I are from the capital of Cantros Seven. How about you?"<br />"I'll bet we were neighbors once&hellip;it's a big town.|Sami and a Cantrosian Rebel|<ref name="SW93" />}}
'''Cantros 7''', or simply '''Cantros''',<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|317|Minka}}</ref> was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Cantros system/Legends|Cantros system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]' [[Saijo sector/Legends|Saijo sector]].

==History==
The world was inhabited by a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Cantrosian|felinoids]], many of whom joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Rebels [[Minka]] and [[Sami (Cantrosian)|Sami]] were [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] in the [[capital of Cantros 7]].<ref name="SW93" />
